decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline-fabrication business, this bracket likely remains near aspiration levels and is cheap to carry with existing capabilities despite limited later website visibility.

This single-model public waste bin is the weakest-fitting diversification, so if its sales have stayed below aspiration levels management would redeploy the resources to the stronger core business or more promising developments.
The waste-bin-with-ashtray line uses the firm's metalworking and coating strengths and its several models suggest enough market testing and slack-supported commitment to continue for now.

The outdoor ashtray line is still outside the core offer but is complementary to the municipal/public-space range, so boundedly rational management would likely keep it unless results clearly fall short of aspiration.
